function.name: update_user_profile
function.description: Updates the user profile with the provided details. If certain details are not provided, existing information is retained. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

user_id.description: The unique identifier for the user.

email.description: The updated email address for the user.

phone.description: The updated phone number for the user in E.164 format, such as '+1234567890'.

preferences.description: The updated preferences for the user. If not provided, the default preferences will be used.

newsletter_subscribed.description: Indicates if the user is subscribed to the newsletter.

birthdate.description: The updated birthdate of the user in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

message.content:
Hey there! 👋 I’m your friendly AI assistant—think of me as a Swiss‑army knife for everyday tasks and questions.

Here’s a quick rundown of what I can help you with:

| Category | What I Can Do |
|----------|---------------|
| **General Knowledge** | Answer trivia, explain concepts, give historical facts, etc. |
| **Writing & Editing** | Draft emails, essays, reports; proofread grammar or style; suggest improvements. |
| **Programming Help** | Explain code snippets, debug logic errors, provide examples in many languages (Python, JavaScript, C++, etc.). |
| **Math & Calculations** | Solve equations, perform algebraic manipulations, compute statistics. |
| **Language Learning** | Translate phrases, practice conversation, explain grammatical rules. |
| **Creative Writing** | Generate stories, poems, dialogues, brainstorm ideas. |
| **Planning & Organization** | Create schedules, set reminders, outline projects, plan trips. |
| **Health & Fitness Tips** | Offer general advice on exercise routines, nutrition basics, wellness habits. *(Not medical diagnosis.)* |
| **Entertainment Suggestions** | Recommend books, movies, music based on interests. |
| **Technical Support** | Troubleshoot common software/hardware issues, guide through setup steps. |

And much more! Just tell me what you need—or even ask “What else?”—and we’ll dive right into it together. 🚀
